one_liner: Cloud-based phone/call center system with a public API for calls, contacts, and users.

auth.evidence_quote: The goal of the OAuth flow is to get an access_token that will be used to authenticate requests to Aircall Public API
auth.notes: Basic Auth (api_id as username, api_token as password) is also supported for direct/internal integrations; OAuth is the recommended path for Technology Partner apps acting on other companies' accounts.

access.evidence_quote: OAuth flow recommended for building apps for companies using Aircall (particularly for Technology Partners)
access.notes: Search-summary evidence only; did not fetch page directly to confirm whether basic-auth API keys are self-serve for a free/dev Aircall account or require a paid plan.

api.evidence_quote: A client_id and client_secret are needed to use the OAuth flow.
api.notes: No official Aircall-published MCP server found; multiple community/unofficial servers exist, explicitly labeled unofficial.

verdict.rationale: Acting on other companies' Aircall accounts via OAuth is positioned for Technology Partners, suggesting a partner program gate beyond simple self-serve signup.
